ana: Quick sanity check on reef-embed-v2 bringup — ran holdout recall + clustering smoke on a 10k wiki subset. numbers below.

matt: awesome, drop numbers?

ana: Ran float32 baseline -> recall@1 0.805, recall@5 0.942
ana: reef-embed-v2 float32 -> recall@1 0.788, recall@5 0.925
ana: reef-embed-v2 int4 (per-channel) -> recall@1 0.774, recall@5 0.918
ana: short queries (<6 tokens) show recall@1 drop ~5% vs baseline

sasha: UMAP looks mostly ok but 3 topic clusters have centroid shifts, also per-example norms down ~0.06
sasha: preview: https://redwood-artifacts.internal/umap/reef-v2/scan.png

leo: which eval command did you run?

ana: ```./eval_embeddings.py --model reef-embed-v2 --dataset wiki10k --quant int4 --seed 42 --k 5 --short-query-threshold 6``` 

ops-bot: canary job started: reef-canary-1768123456 (staging, 50k queries)

matt: can you also run int8 and float16 for comparison? try per-channel vs per-tensor quant and report recall deltas by length bucket.

ana: on it — scheduling int8/int4/per-tensor runs now, will push artifacts to /artifacts/reef-v2/1768123456

ana: filing ENG-1423 to track centroid shift + short-query regression, assigning to @sasha

sasha: ack, will look into whether it's a whitening/centering mismatch or a training-distribution shift; will check layernorm scaling and mean-centering of embeddings.

vikram: LGTM to continue experiments but gate release on canary: if recall@1 drop >2% we rollback. :alert:

matt: noted — added eval hook in Console to alert on regression >1.5% and to post per-query diffs to the rollout logs.

ana: added the hook and started the canary; will paste final metrics here when done :hourglass:

sasha: :eyes:
vikram: :thumbsup:
